name: Beauty Dish
description: One soft circular beauty-dish key light held close and centered above the model, producing a real round catchlight, a genuine butterfly shadow under the nose, and true matte-to-satin skin — the register of an actual high-end beauty shoot, not a glossed digital render.
lighting: Close overhead beauty dish, real butterfly shadow
subject: person
prompt: a close chest-up crop of a solo model against a warm ivory-champagne seamless studio ground, lit by one soft circular beauty-dish key light positioned close and slightly above the eyeline so it casts a genuine small butterfly-shaped shadow directly beneath the nose and a soft shadow under the chin — the physical signature of a real beauty dish, not an even frontal wash, a single round soft-edged catchlight high in each eye, skin rendered as real skin in a professional beauty photograph: predominantly matte with only a narrow satin sheen along the tops of the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose where facial oil naturally sits, visible pore structure at close range, fine vellus hair catching light along the jaw and hairline, natural asymmetry between the two sides of the face, subtle real-skin imperfections left intact — a faint freckle, a slight redness at the nostril crease — never uniformly smoothed, never wet-looking or plastic, never a synthetic all-over glow, true photographic falloff from the lit forehead down into softer shadow at the neck, shallow depth of field with the eyes tack-sharp and the ears already softening, the finish of a real retouched editorial beauty photograph where retouching removed blemishes but left texture, no other people in frame
